candidate_relations.rationale: The current clean-source workflow's exact mirroring and installed-tree exclusion strengthen the broader clean-source promotion workflow proposition.
The current workflow's refusal to push after release-source movement strengthens the clean-source workflow's stale-head protection requirement.
Activation tests requiring exact authorized scope and proving activation creates no authority strengthen the broader Rupi/RIL conformance record around accepted authority boundaries.

Production-invocation tests with distinct immutable submission identities and protocol-valid submissions strengthen the broader conformance record that candidate production stays on the accepted path.

The production status record's PASS with both semantic-reconciliation and canonical-mutation authority false strengthens the production-invocation test proposition that authority and Canon remain unchanged.
Runtime-isolation tests running installed validation and admission pressure locally with network blocked strengthen the production-invocation no-source-fallback proposition.
Network-blocked local installer and runtime-isolation tests strengthen the installer-runner contract's network-independent local execution design.
The explicit no-network-I/O contract clause strengthens the broader installer-runner proposition that rd_install.py is network-independent.
The staged deterministic-installer record with integrity, compatibility, drift, idempotence, and update checks strengthens the accepted deterministic installer-runner contract.
The Distiller core's immutable raw-candidate/submission writes strengthen the greenfield workflow's immutable finalize/replay candidate path.
Distiller rejection of evidence path, digest, and source-registry mismatches strengthens the invocation-request schema's evidence/source-registry constraints.
Human-Agent tests performing D3 revalidation immediately before approval creation strengthen the pre-approval applicability/revalidation design requirement.
The ordinary-repair runtime's validation of authoritative history and projection replacement without history edits strengthens the ordinary-repair test proposition.
Ordinary-repair tests proving projections rebuild from valid untouched history strengthen the mutation runtime proposition that projections are replay-derived from authoritative events.
Production-invocation tests showing distinct valid immutable submissions strengthen the greenfield workflow's immutable candidate-submission behavior.

The production status record's explicit false semantic-reconciliation and canonical-mutation authority flags strengthen the Rupi conformance proposition that no alternate semantic or Canon-mutation path exists.
The protected initial-operator runtime path strengthens the operator-management contract's separation of protected-root ceremonies from ordinary operator changes.
Grant-operation tests allowing exact non-root disable while rejecting protected-root disable strengthen the operator-management delegation boundary.
Operator-management tests allowing non-root changes while preventing protected-root mutation strengthen the protected-root contract boundary.
The bounded-grant design's active-grant and immutable-workflow containment requirements strengthen the authority-grant runtime's exact evidence and lifecycle validation proposition.
Grant-operation tests exercising bounded grant issuance/application and protected-operation rejection strengthen the authority-grant runtime proposition.
The Rupi authority adapter's prepare/confirm separation and return to Human control strengthen the Human-Agent tests' protected-ceremony boundary proposition.
Human-Agent tests keeping protected ceremonies explicit strengthen the Rupi authority adapter's preparation-versus-confirmation boundary.
The read-only checkpoint adapter is concrete evidence strengthening the Rupi lifecycle-agent design's requirement that Rupi-owned semantics not perform consequential mutation.
Keeping protected authority setup outside Rupi's install/bootstrap surface strengthens the lifecycle-agent design's no-authority-state boundary.
The broad Rupi conformance record strengthens the lifecycle-agent design proposition that Rupi has no alternate semantic, authority, or mutation systems.
The admission contract making R13 the sole canonical mutation primitive strengthens the Rupi conformance proposition that Rupi has no Canon-mutation path.
The deterministic admission proof's exact-base guarded-update and identity-preservation checks strengthen the preserved reference transaction's guarded-update proposition.
